t: Enquiry From Inspector-General Of Police, Hong Kong Re Miss E.L. Aksenova

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY
H852
20, 5 p3

May          24          33.

Confidential.

Sir,

    I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No. C.I.D. 52/1520/33 of May 2nd, 1933,
and to state that there is nothing on record in this
office regarding Miss E.L. Aksenova. Enquiries have
been made but no information has been elicited regarding
this individual. She has not registered with the Shanghai
Public Safety Bureau or any of the local Russian Emigrants'
Organizations.

                    I have the honour to be,
                            Sir,
                Your most obedient servant,

                    (Sd) F. W. Gerrard

                Commissioner of Police.

Inspector General of Police,
    Police Headquarters,
        Hongkong.

Date May 25, 1933

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Enquiry from Inspector-General of Police, Hongkong, re:
Miss E.L. Aksenova

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the letter dated May 2, 1933 from the
Inspector-General of Police, Hongkong, on the subject of Miss E.L.
Aksenova, enquiries have failed to elicit any information regarding
this individual.
She is not registered with the Shanghai Public Safety
Bureau or any of the local Russian Emigrants' Organizations. It
is, therefore, possible that she visited Shanghai only for a
short period prior to her departure for Canton.
There is nothing in Municipal Police records regarding
this person.
[左侧页边注：OK]
Enquiries are proceeding.

A. Prokofiev
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

POLICE HEADQUARTERS,
HONG KONG.

CONFIDENTIAL.

2nd.May, 1933.

Sir,

I have the honour to address you on the subject
of a former Russian citizen named Miss E.L. Aksenova,
who is at present in Canton, to which place she went
from Shanghai about a month ago. This lady has made
an application through the Consulate General, Canton,
for a visa to come to this Colony for the purpose of
taking up employment as housekeeper with a Mr. Ragusini.
I shall be grateful if you can supply me with
any particulars of this lady's activities while in
Shanghai.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕

p. Inspector General of Police.

A.S. Prokofieff
SBReg/s.

The Deputy Commissioner ( Crime),
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

AC(Sp Br)
Kindly put up report.

Sd, For attention please

1933年5月2日。

先生：

谨就前俄国公民E.L. Aksenova女士一事致函阁下。该女士目前身在广州，约于一个月前从上海前往该地。这位女士已通过驻广州总领事馆申请签证，以便前来本殖民地受雇于Ragusini先生，担任管家职务。
如蒙提供该女士在上海期间活动的任何详情，不胜感激。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

〔签名〕

代警察总监。

A.S. Prokofieff
SBReg/s.

副总监（刑事），
上海公共租界工部局，
上海。

AC(特务科)
请提交报告。

〔印：副总监 / 1933年5月8日 / (刑事科)〕
